source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: An identification card and an MDC endorsement both last six years, while a learner's permit lasts two years from issue.
corrections.note: The two year learner permit period is stated on page nine, not on the cited page eight.

corrections.corrected_statement: Renewing a license expired at least one hundred eighty days but not more than five years requires paying an administrative penalty and passing a knowledge exam and standard vision screening, while renewing after five years or more also requires passing a driving skills exam.
corrections.note: Added the missing administrative penalty for both renewal tiers.

corrections.corrected_statement: A person fifteen years of age or older without a driver license may operate a watercraft with more than ten horsepower only after completing an approved boater education course while carrying a valid Indiana identification card, and a person younger than fifteen years of age may not operate such a watercraft.
corrections.note: Added the missing valid Indiana identification card possession requirement.

corrections.corrected_statement: Vehicles carrying passengers for hire, all school buses, and vehicles carrying explosives or flammable liquids must stop no closer than fifteen feet and no farther than fifty feet from the nearest rail at a railroad crossing, except where tracks are abandoned with posted signs or have been removed.
corrections.note: Added the abandoned or removed tracks exception to the always stop rule.

corrections.corrected_statement: A Notice of Action form counts as lawful status proof only when the Bureau of Motor Vehicles can verify that the Department of Homeland Security received it and has not denied action and you also provide additional federal agency documents showing lawful status that pertain to the Notice of Action.
corrections.note: Added the missing requirement for additional pertaining federal agency lawful status documents.

corrections.corrected_statement: For the first one hundred eighty days you may not drive from ten at night to five in the morning and after that while under eighteen you may not drive after eleven at night Sunday through Thursday or before five in the morning Monday through Friday or from one in the morning to five in the morning Saturday and Sunday unless going to work school or religious activity or accompanied by a qualified adult or spouse.
corrections.note: Added the omitted Monday through Friday before five in the morning limit and the work school religious and supervised exceptions.

corrections.corrected_statement: A CDL lasts four years, and licenses for lawful temporary residents may not follow the standard validity periods.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but appears on page fourteen not page sixteen.

corrections.corrected_statement: Probationary drivers may not use any telecommunications device while driving except to make a nine one one emergency call while all drivers may not type transmit or read a text or email while driving except with hands free or voice operated technology or to make a nine one one emergency call.
corrections.note: Added the missing nine one one exception to the all driver texting rule and clarified the two separate rules.
